title: Cannabis Phytochemical Atlas369 — Cannabiverse Graph
scope_note: 145 is the confirmed Atlas set reconciled in this release, not a claim that only 145 phytocannabinoids exist. Reviews published in 2022 describe more than 160 isoprenylated resorcinyl polyketides from Cannabis.
id_policy: CPA-CAN identifiers are permanent opaque Atlas identifiers. They do not encode discovery priority, potency, biological importance, or publication chronology.
